frontendOwnershipTransfer.readiness: Source-only, asset-free baseline; not a working app or generated renderer.

licenseObligations.owner: Lead; Stephen Long/coordinator confirms disposition before redistribution

findings.subject: Inherited pwmarcz code
findings.license: MIT for original code, expressly excluding images/sounds
findings.obligation: Retain original copyright and permission notice with substantial copied code; provide shipped third-party notices.

findings.subject: Fork backend/original additions
evidence: tracked license inventory only found frontend COPYING
findings.license: No separate backend/root grant found in the audited tracked files; nested MIT/manifest is not proof every fork addition or asset has that grant.
findings.disposition: Owner requested development/import, so local implementation can proceed. Lead obtains an explicit root/additions licensing decision from Stephen Long before distributing a Docker image.

findings.subject: Autotable tile artwork and derivatives
findings.license: CC BY-NC-SA stated for Kanojo tile images; exact version/complete asset chain not established
findings.disposition: Do not import/reuse img/tiles.svg, generated tile PNG/atlas/labels, icon derivatives or atlas-bearing models in the new product. Original procedural Unity art and original DOM labels/icons replace them.

findings.subject: Autotable table/sound/font/cheatsheets
findings.license: README: table Fabric030 and OpenGameArt sounds CC0; Segment7 OFL; about: cheatsheets CC BY-NC4.0 and their FluffyStuff tiles CC BY4.0
findings.disposition: Not needed for simplest migration; import none of these third-party binaries/PDFs. If later reuse is wanted, verify per-file provenance/license version and fulfill separate obligations first.

findings.subject: Fork sound.ts
findings.license: Synth code with zero static audio assets per existing credits; credits mention /COPYING but actual notice is nested
findings.disposition: Keep browser synth behavior with code notices; do not assert synthesized code/audio is automatically CC0 or copy legacy static sound bundles.

findings.subject: Unity example original code
findings.disposition: Inspect-only in this recommendation; no copied code means no new code attribution burden from this reference.

findings.subject: Unity example assets and bundled SDKs
findings.license: README says resources fetched from Majsoul; MIT code notice does not establish rights to those external resources. Bundled Photon/DOTween/fonts have distinct terms.
findings.disposition: Import none; do not copy a whole example project or upgrade its asset tree.

findings.subject: New assets
findings.license: Original generated meshes/textures/ASCII suit labels and simple original icons, with creator/source/license recorded.
findings.disposition: Unity owns procedural meshes/textures. Frontend owns original DOM tile labels/icons. Use Unity-provided runtime components only under their applicable terms; no outside font/texture/model without provenance.

findings.subject: Dependency notices
findings.disposition: Backend retains npm/NuGet and Unity-package notices/SBOM in distribution, including any MPL/Apache dependencies; do not infer package.json MIT relicenses dependencies.

licenseObligations.distributionGate: No blanket 'all assets/code MIT' claim. Owner license decision and shipped notices are required before release, independently of passing builds.

configurationPolicy: No live .env or appsettings.Development.json read/imported; credential-bearing safe config fields blanked; SQLite defaults retained.
phaseArchivePolicy: Root Phase_* archives are excluded; nested C# regression source/tests remain included.
